newsitem.title: USA: Genesco names Harris president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Genesco names Harris president, COO.

text.p: Genesco Inc said on Wednesday Ben Harris was named president and chief operating officer and a director of the company.
The footwear distributor said in a statement that Harris, 52, replaces David Chamberlain, who retains his titles of chairman and chief executive.
Chamberlain will remain as chairman and chief executive officer through Jan 31, 1997. On Feb 1, Harris is expected to become president and chief executive.
Chamberlain is expected to continue as chairman.
Harris was Genesco's executive vice president for operations and head of retail operations.
